title: Burgman 400 ABS Maxi (Urban Carbon)
description: Representing Suzuki's prowess in the Commuter Scooter class, the Suzuki Burgman 400 ABS Maxi (Urban Carbon) is delivers ultra-nimble urban agility for riders navigating congested city centers. A 400cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
